base_url.label: API base URL
base_url.description: Address of the API, including the version path. Adjust this if the service does not run where it normally would, for example on another machine than Music Assistant.

api_key.label: API key
api_key.description: Leave empty for a local server that does not ask for a key. When changing these settings later, leave it empty to keep the key you already saved.

clear_api_key.label: Remove the saved API key
clear_api_key.description: Tick this when moving to a service that does not use a key.

models.label: Models
models.description: Pick the models you want to use. Each one becomes a separate choice for the AI features, so you can use a fast model for simple tasks and a smarter one where it matters.

service.title: Choose a service
service.description: Anything that speaks the OpenAI API works here. Pick one of the services below to fill in its address for you, or choose "Something else" to enter your own.

connection.title: Connection details
connection.description: Once connected, choose the models you want to use in the provider settings.

errors.invalid_api_key: The service did not accept this API key. Check the key and try again.
errors.cannot_connect: Could not reach the service. Check the base URL and make sure the service is running.

manifest.description: Use any service that speaks the OpenAI API for Music Assistant's AI features, including OpenAI, Groq, OpenRouter, Together and local servers such as Ollama or LM Studio.
